High protein diets require high stomach acid and sufficient pepsin (a proteolytic enzyme) to digest and assimilate proteins fully and rapidly.

Low stomach acid is common and can result from: 

  • Stress
  • H-pylori infection
  • Using anti-acids (PPIs)
  • Poor gut health (dysbiosis)
  • Aging

HD Muscle Betaine HCL is a highly bioavailable source of hydrochloric acid (HCL). In the stomach’s gastric juice, high acidity is required to chemically digest our food, especially proteins. 

Optimal gastric HCL is necessary to absorb proteins, calcium, Vitamin B12, and iron. Gastric HCL also promotes the formation and activation of pepsin, the key enzyme for protein digestion.

HD Muscle Betaine HCL is a therapeutic digestive aid formulated for those on a high protein diet. Each capsule contains 700 mg Betaine HCL and 50 mg Pepsin A (1:10,000 - 500,000 FCC Pepsin Units). 

Directions: Take 1 capsule up to 3x daily with high protein meals. DO NOT take on empty stomach.

Each capsule contains a highly bioavailable form of Zinc Bisglycinate, ensuring maximum absorption and efficacy. With the added benefit of Copper (II) Bisglycinate, this supplement helps maintain a healthy balance of these crucial minerals in the body.

Benefits of Zinc

Zinc is a vital mineral that plays a crucial role in numerous physiological functions. Adequate zinc levels are essential for:

  • Immune Function: Zinc supports the body's natural defense system, helping to maintain immune responses and protect against oxidative stress.
  • Cellular Function: It aids in DNA synthesis, cell division, and protein production, making it indispensable for growth and development.
  • Skin Health: Zinc promotes skin integrity and wound healing, ensuring your skin remains healthy and resilient.
  • Cognitive Function: Adequate zinc levels support cognitive performance and neurological health.

Balanced with Copper

Our formula includes Copper (II) Bisglycinate to ensure a balanced intake of these two essential minerals. Copper is important for:

  • Iron Metabolism: Copper aids in iron absorption and utilization, contributing to the formation of red blood cells.
  • Antioxidant Defense: It supports antioxidant enzyme systems, protecting cells from damage.
  • Nervous System Health: Copper is involved in neurotransmitter synthesis and maintenance of myelin, which is crucial for nerve function.

Suggested Use

Take one capsule daily with a meal or as directed by your healthcare professional. This product is designed for adults seeking to support their immune function, skin health, and overall well-being.

Our Zinc supplement is manufactured in a state-of-the-art facility, adhering to strict quality control standards to ensure purity, potency, and consistency. Each batch is rigorously tested to guarantee that you receive the highest quality product. Maintain optimal health and wellness with our Zinc supplement, expertly formulated to provide you with the essential minerals your body needs.
